clue.text: A degree, as the writer put it, is essential

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree
sic is the Latin tag marking words quoted exactly as the writer wrote them

explanation.surface: A remark that a university degree is, in the author's own words, indispensable.
explanation.walkthrough: The opening 'A' only joins; the degree itself supplies BA.
explanation.definitionFit: Something basic is fundamental, a synonym of essential.

clue.text: It's about chaps, not maps, said Bentley

definitions.text: It's about chaps, not maps, said Bentley

parts.words: It's about chaps, not maps, said Bentley
parts.note: E. C. Bentley's famous comic verse contrasts geography, which concerns maps, with the kind of life-writing that concerns people

explanation.surface: A quotation from the writer Bentley contrasting chaps with maps.
explanation.walkthrough: Bentley's verse runs: 'Geography is about maps, but this is about chaps'. Knowing the quote gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A life story written about a person is concerned with chaps, not maps, in Bentley's phrasing.

clue.text: Note a proviso for raising capital

parts.note: so (or soh) is the fifth note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: in a down clue, raising means the words a and proviso are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: if introduces a condition or proviso

explanation.surface: A musical note with a condition attached, used to raise funds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for raising' turns the pair upwards (FIA) in this down clue. 'Raising capital' reads as fundraising, but the capital is a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Sofia is the capital city of Bulgaria.

clue.text: The proper name for a short 1 dn

definitions.text: The proper name for a short 1 dn

parts.words: The proper name for a short 1 dn
parts.note: a short comic verse life sketch is named after its inventor, so its name is literally a proper name, Bentley's middle name

explanation.surface: A pedantic note on the correct term for a brief life story.
explanation.walkthrough: The four-line comic verse form was invented by Edmund Clerihew Bentley and carries his middle name, so 'proper name' is a pun on a personal name.
explanation.definitionFit: This verse form is a short comic poem about a person, in effect a miniature life story.

clue.text: Effeminate Conservative has a mane on which he could sit

parts.note: camp describes exaggeratedly effeminate manner
a mane is a head of long hair

explanation.surface: A flamboyant Tory with a lion's mane of hair, and what he sits on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' is only a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A folding seat for outdoor use is something a person could sit on.

clue.text: Company project

definitions.meaning: the actors in a play form its company

explanation.definitionFit: A theatre company's troupe of actors is its cast; to cast is to throw or project.

clue.text: She takes people for handwork

parts.note: reads like a manual employer, but describes a beautician who takes clients in to treat their hands and nails

explanation.surface: An employer who hires workers for manual labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'handwork' suggests manual labour; it is literally work on hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A beautician who trims and polishes fingernails works on clients' hands.

clue.text: Sleepy place for a Rocker

parts.note: a Rocker suggests a 1960s motorcycle youth, but the bed in question itself rocks a baby to sleep

explanation.surface: Where a leather-clad 1960s Rocker might nod off.
explanation.walkthrough: Rockers were British motorbike gangs of the 1960s; here the thing that rocks is the baby's bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A baby's rocking bed is a place for sleep that rocks.

clue.text: State in which one doesn't feel oneself, as in a gale at sea

definitions.text: State in which one doesn't feel oneself

indicators.note: at sea means confused or disordered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Feeling out of sorts, like someone tossed in a storm at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' rearranges AS IN A GALE. 'doesn't feel oneself' means literally feels no pain, not 'is unwell'.
explanation.definitionFit: Analgesia is insensibility to pain, a medical state of not feeling.

clue.text: Memorial to priest captured by a Roman

indicators.note: captured by means the priest is held inside the letters for a Roman

parts.note: RC, Roman Catholic, a Roman in church terms
Eli is the priest in the Book of Samuel

explanation.surface: A monument to a priest who was taken prisoner by a Roman.
explanation.walkthrough: Eli, the Old Testament priest, is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is a keepsake surviving from the past, a memorial of it.

clue.text: Not on time when trade is slack

parts.note: off is the opposite of on
a season is a period of time

explanation.surface: Being late during a quiet spell for business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not on time' reads as 'late' but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: The quiet part of the year for a resort or business is the period of low demand.

clue.text: Use as a face-saver in speech

indicators.note: in speech means the words are spoken aloud and give a different spelling

parts.note: a veil covers and protects the face

explanation.surface: Employing something as an excuse to avoid embarrassment when talking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'face-saver' suggests avoiding humiliation; literally it is a veil shielding the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or benefit, as in 'of no avail'.

clue.text: He organises group travel that's the way to start

indicators.note: to start puts the way at the beginning of the answer

parts.note: a road is a way
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A tour organiser explaining how to begin a trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'group' is a band: a roadie moves the band's gear on tour.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadie handles transport and equipment for a touring band.

clue.text: Start to encourage firm thinking about the environment

indicators.note: start to means only the first letter of encourage is taken

parts.note: Co. abbreviates company, a firm
logic is reasoned thinking

explanation.surface: An urge to begin thinking hard about green issues.
explanation.definitionFit: Ecologic means concerned with ecology, the study of living things and their surroundings.

clue.text: Implying blame in this case

definitions.meaning: suggesting that someone is at fault
grammatical case of a direct object

explanation.definitionFit: Accusative means charging with wrongdoing, and is also the grammatical case for a direct object.

clue.text: Sprinkle cereal with spice

parts.note: to pepper is to sprinkle or scatter over
corn is a cereal crop

explanation.surface: Cooking instructions: dust the breakfast cereal with a seasoning.
explanation.definitionFit: A peppercorn is the dried berry ground to make the seasoning pepper.

clue.text: Fellow in game with expert has a blank look

indicators.note: in means the letter for fellow goes inside the run of game plus expert

parts.note: poker is a card game
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: A man playing cards with a champion keeps an expressionless face.
explanation.definitionFit: An expressionless face that hides one's feelings is a blank look.

clue.text: Drink it as a cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so these two words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Have a mixed drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as a cocktail' signals mixing IT AS.
explanation.definitionFit: Asti is an Italian sparkling wine.

clue.text: In short, curt, discontented and cross

parts.note: terse means short or brusque

indicators.note: discontented means curt loses its contents, keeping only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone abrupt, unhappy and angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like an adjective in the list of moods; it is the verb meaning meet across.
explanation.definitionFit: Intersect means to cut across or cross each other.

clue.text: Made a tin shape into a glittering decoration

indicators.note: to shape is to form anew, so these letters are reformed

explanation.surface: Fashioning a tin into a sparkly ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamante is sparkling trimming made of glass or paste.

clue.text: It's acceptable in the old couple

indicators.note: in means acceptable sits inside the old form of the

parts.note: ye is the archaic form of the
OK means acceptable

explanation.surface: Approval of an elderly pair.
explanation.definitionFit: To yoke is to link or join together two things.

clue.text: Heraldic officer's leading position in the profession

indicators.note: in means the leading position is held within the profession

parts.note: a pursuit is an occupation or calling
the van is the foremost part, as in vanguard

explanation.surface: A heraldry official holds a top place in his career.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A pursuivant is a junior officer of arms ranking below a herald.

clue.text: Mounted soldier in retreat in bizarre clothes

indicators.note: in means the upturned soldier sits inside the retreat

parts.note: a rout is a disorderly retreat

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounted means the soldier is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A cavalryman fleeing in strange attire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mounted soldier' suggests a cavalryman; 'Mounted' turns GI upwards to IG.
explanation.definitionFit: A rig-out is an outfit, often an odd or showy one.

clue.text: A buttoned-up Lord?

parts.note: buttoned-up suggests a stiff, reserved aristocrat, but points to the knitted jacket named after the Earl who led the Light Brigade

explanation.surface: A reserved, tight-lipped peer.
explanation.walkthrough: The knitted button-front jacket is named after the 7th Earl of Cardigan, of the Charge of the Light Brigade.
explanation.definitionFit: A buttoned knitted jacket shares its name with a British earl.

clue.text: Young animal — it's about as long as your arm

definitions.text: about as long as your arm

parts.note: a cub is a young fox, bear or lion
it, with the 's as is, a link

explanation.surface: A baby creature roughly the length of your arm.
explanation.definitionFit: A cubit is an ancient length measure, from elbow to fingertip.

clue.text: Puffer, or a section of it

definitions.meaning: a puffer is also a steam train, and this is a carriage of it where puffing was allowed

explanation.definitionFit: A smoker is someone who smokes tobacco, and a railway carriage set aside for smoking.

clue.text: Struck finally with No 1 iron, and cut

indicators.note: finally means only the last letter of struck is taken

parts.note: N abbreviates number
the Roman numeral I is one
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A golfer finally hitting with a number one iron, then slicing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No 1 iron' is a golf club, but splits into N, I and FE.
explanation.definitionFit: To knife is to stab or cut with a blade.

clue.text: Retainer, for an author

parts.note: a retainer suggests a fee or servant, but here is the proof-reader's mark telling the printer to keep a deleted word

explanation.surface: An author's fee paid in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: A retainer is usually an advance fee; here it is the instruction meaning 'let it stand'.
explanation.definitionFit: Stet is Latin for 'let it stand', a mark restoring text struck out in proofs.

clue.text: Vote against a celebration

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as '...', to cast a negative vote

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading splits as BE A NO, to be a 'no' vote. A beano is British slang for a party.
explanation.definitionFit: Beano is British slang for a jolly party or spree.

clue.text: All-out event is in disarray

indicators.note: disarray is disorder, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A no-holds-barred competition is in chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link before 'disarray' but is part of the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Intensive means concentrated and thorough, all-out effort.

clue.text: Dealing with management

definitions.meaning: the way one handles someone or something
medical care of a patient or condition

explanation.definitionFit: Treatment is the way one handles a person, and the medical care given for an illness.

clue.text: Put out fire

explanation.definitionFit: To eject is to expel someone, or to dismiss and throw them out.
